name: Grelin's Report
summary: Grelin's Report is a dispatch written by Grelin Whitebeard detailing the Frostmane troll situation in Coldridge Valley. Entrusted to an adventurer rather than a novice apprentice, it serves as the official link between the scouts guarding Anvilmar and Senir Whitebeard stationed in Kharanos.

sections.title: A Dispatch Past the Troggs
sections.body: Written after observing the Frostmane trolls in Coldridge Valley, Grelin's Report concludes that they pose no large threat and can be dealt with by the Mountaineers already stationed there and mercenaries paid from Senate funds. Rather than trusting his fumbling apprentice with such vital intelligence, Grelin enlists a capable traveler to carry the document through the trogg-infested Coldridge Pass. The paper acts as an official pass through Mountaineer Thalos's blockade, proving the bearer travels on urgent business to the wider snowy expanse of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Ruffling Feathers in Kharanos
sections.body: When delivered to Senir Whitebeard at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, the report provides critical field updates intended for Ironforge. Senir notes with amused resignation that his brother invoked King Magni Bronzebeard's name liberally throughout the text. Grelin claims the King's sanction for the action, and Senir expects that appeal to royal authority to ruffle some feathers in the Ironforge Senate.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Grelin's Report?
faq.answer: The report carries Grelin Whitebeard's assessment of the Frostmane trolls from Coldridge Valley to his brother Senir in Kharanos. It assures leadership outside the valley that the trolls pose no large threat and can be handled by local Mountaineers and Senate-funded mercenaries.

faq.q: Why can't Grelin deliver it himself?
aliases: why entrust it to an adventurer
faq.answer: Grelin remains stationed in Coldridge Valley monitoring the trolls. While he initially considered sending his apprentice, the perilous journey through the trogg-infested tunnel prompted him to hand the vital papers to a battle-tested adventurer instead.

faq.q: Why does Mountaineer Thalos let you pass with the report?
aliases: why does thalos let me through
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos guards the tunnel out of Coldridge Valley to keep civilians safe from vicious troggs. Possessing Grelin's Report proves you are traveling on pressing dwarven defense business, convincing Thalos to grant passage.

faq.q: Why is the Ironforge Senate annoyed by the report?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard notes that Grelin invoked King Magni's name liberally throughout the document. Bypassing standard diplomatic subtleties to demand royal attention often angers the bureaucrats in the Ironforge Senate, even if the brothers agree the politicians need a wake-up call.

angles.text: Carrying this report is a dwarf's passage from the safe training grounds of Coldridge into the broader defense of the Dun Morogh heartland and the service of Ironforge.
Delivering Grelin's message allows gnomish refugees to prove their mettle to dwarven mountaineers while traversing the shared mountain passes of Dun Morogh.
